activities.instructions: Ayuda a la rana a cruzar el río eligiendo el nenúfar correcto en cada salto.
activities.prompt: Partida de 8 rondas para repasar el tema jugando.

rounds.prompt: Online appointments are quick for many users. ___ A phone option should therefore remain available.

options.text: The receptionist takes lunch at noon.
However, some residents do not have reliable internet access.
The website uses a blue logo.

rounds.explanation: However introduces the limitation that justifies the second sentence.

rounds.prompt: More cycle lanes would make short journeys safer. ___ This would encourage people to leave their cars at home.

options.text: The park closes at sunset.
The timetable was printed yesterday.
They would separate cyclists from heavy traffic.

rounds.explanation: The sentence gives a reason for the safety claim.

rounds.prompt: Solar panels require an initial investment. ___ The long-term reduction in energy costs makes the plan worth examining.

options.text: The roof is made of tiles.
The family moved in May.
Although the cost is significant, the panels could lower household bills.

rounds.explanation: The missing sentence contains both the concession and the benefit.

rounds.prompt: The new booking scheme has reduced missed appointments. ___ This improvement should be monitored over the next quarter.

options.text: Appointments are usually twenty minutes long.
The reduction in missed appointments suggests that reminders are working.
The reception desk is near the window.

rounds.explanation: The noun phrase identifies the precise improvement.

rounds.prompt: Schools can reduce food waste without changing the whole menu. ___ This would prevent unopened food from being thrown away.

options.text: For example, they could offer surplus portions at the end of lunch.
The kitchen has four large windows.
The pupils study geography on Fridays.

rounds.explanation: The example is a practical way to reduce the stated waste.

rounds.prompt: Residents repeatedly mentioned the unsafe crossing. ___ The council should install a raised crossing.

options.text: Residents meet in the nearby hall.
This evidence indicates that the current arrangement needs to change.
The council uses electric cars.

rounds.explanation: The sentence interprets the repeated evidence before the proposal.

rounds.prompt: Libraries should open later once a week. ___ This would allow more workers to borrow books after work.

options.text: Many residents finish work after the current closing time.
The librarian enjoys historical novels.
The building was opened in 1982.

rounds.explanation: The sentence explains why later opening would help.

rounds.prompt: Several passengers reported late buses. ___ As a result, some people arrived after their shifts had begun.

options.text: The café sells soup at lunchtime.
The delays were especially common on the evening route.
The room has three windows.

rounds.explanation: The missing sentence narrows the evidence before its consequence.

activities.explanation: Al terminar la partida verás la media de aciertos y la explicación de cada ronda fallada.

activities.instructions: Colócate en el carril de la respuesta correcta antes de cruzar cada puerta.
activities.prompt: Partida de 8 rondas para repasar el tema jugando.

rounds.prompt: Some residents are concerned about the cost of the proposal. ___ It would nevertheless improve access for people without cars.

options.text: The car park is often full.
The proposal is printed on recycled paper.
Even so, the long-term social benefit should be considered.

rounds.explanation: Even so acknowledges the concern and restores the argument.

rounds.prompt: Public parks give residents space to exercise and meet. They also support local wildlife. ___

options.text: The council office has a new lift.
The park gate is made of metal.
For these reasons, their maintenance should remain a council priority.

rounds.explanation: For these reasons links the conclusion to both benefits.

rounds.prompt: The new online form gives users the information they need. ___ Staff can spend more time on complex enquiries.

options.text: As a result, routine phone calls have become less frequent.
The form is available in two colours.
The office opens at nine.

rounds.explanation: As a result connects the information to the benefit for staff.

rounds.prompt: The evidence shows that evening access is limited, while daytime sessions are well used. ___ This would test demand without changing the whole service.

options.text: The council building has two entrances.
For these reasons, the council should fund a one-year evening trial.
The service uses a monthly calendar.

rounds.explanation: The recommendation follows both findings and the final sentence explains its scale.

rounds.prompt: Fewer cars would improve air quality near the school. ___ Parents could also feel more confident about walking there.

options.text: The bus has blue seats.
This change would reduce the amount of traffic at the gate.
The school kitchen serves breakfast at eight.

rounds.explanation: The sentence explains how the proposed change would work.

rounds.prompt: Digital forms can speed up applications. ___ An alternative should still be available.

options.text: Applicants often use blue pens.
The application has four pages.
Nevertheless, they may exclude people without reliable internet access.

rounds.explanation: Nevertheless marks the contrast that supports an alternative.

rounds.prompt: The same problem appeared in several interviews. ___ The service should test a clearer process before expanding it.

options.text: This repeated evidence suggests that the current process needs attention.
The interviews lasted ten minutes.
The service uses a digital calendar.

rounds.explanation: The sentence interprets repeated evidence before the recommendation.

rounds.prompt: The pilot reduced average waiting time by ten minutes. ___ It therefore appears to have improved access for participants.

options.text: This reduction in waiting time was recorded during the four-week trial.
The office has white walls.
Some users prefer morning appointments.

rounds.explanation: The reference names the reduction and limits its time frame.

activities.explanation: Al terminar la partida verás la media de aciertos y la explicación de cada ronda fallada.
